Environment Canada, Greenhouse Gas Division (2000). Canada's Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990-1998: Final Submission to the UNFCCC Secretariat, October 2000, Volume 2 of 2: Appendices. Cat. No. EN 49-5/5-9-2-1998E-IN, ISBN 0-662-29576-5. 162 pp.

EMISSION-FACTOR / INVENTORY REFERENCE, SUPERSEDED - NO TECHNOLOGY DATA. Volume 2 holds Appendix 1 (rough estimate of emissions associated with fossil-fuel exports: about 28 Mt CO2e from net natural gas exports and 19 Mt from net crude oil exports in 1998; 13 and 9 Mt in 1990) and Appendix 2 (UNFCCC Common Reporting Format tables for 1998 and 1990 and recalculation tables 1991-1997: activity data, implied emission factors and emissions by sector). No technology-level numbers and no stand-alone emission-factor table (only implied emission factors, which depend on the unit of activity data). Superseded by the later inventories, currently ECCC (2026) NIR 1990-2024 (Annex 6 factors, eccc_2026_001). Unique content: the 1990 and 1998 export-embedded emission estimates are sector totals only; nothing for the database.
